script:
git -C /workspace/image-generation pull --ff-only >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
TOK=$(cat ~/.cache/huggingface/token)
set -e
RES=/workspace/results/gsplat_kazbek-run-s2-surfel-dense
CKPT=$(ls $RES/ckpts/ckpt_*_rank0.pt | sort -V | tail -1)
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/export_ply.py "$CKPT" /tmp/kazbek-run-s2-surfel-dense.ply
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/strip_sky.py /tmp/kazbek-run-s2-surfel-dense.ply /workspace/scenes/kazbek-run-c10 <(curl -sfL -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" "https://huggingface.co/datasets/miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets/resolve/main/scenes/kazbek-run-c10/normalization.json") --margin-m 80 || true
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/hf_upload.py --repo miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets --prefix checkpoints/kazbek-run-s2-surfel-dense "$CKPT" /tmp/kazbek-run-s2-surfel-dense.ply
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
STAGE=/workspace/vault-stage-s2-surfel-dense/world/kazbek-c10
mkdir -p $STAGE
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write /workspace/image-generation/splat-viewer/build-octree.ts /tmp/kazbek-run-s2-surfel-dense.ply $STAGE/octree-run-s2-surfel-dense
D=$(ls -d $STAGE/*octree* | head -1)
[ "$D" = "$STAGE/octree-run-s2-surfel-dense" ] || mv "$D" $STAGE/octree-run-s2-surfel-dense
python3 -c "from huggingface_hub import HfApi; HfApi().upload_large_folder(folder_path='/workspace/vault-stage-s2-surfel-dense', repo_id='miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets', repo_type='dataset', print_report=False)"
echo FINALIZE-s2-surfel-dense-DONE
